summary: Gray Media, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing it priced a $750 million offering of 7.500% senior secured first lien notes due 2034 in a private placement under Rule 144A/Regulation S. Proceeds will redeem part of its 10.500% notes due 2029, repay revolving credit borrowings, and pay fees. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation; no equity event, strategic review, or control change is involved. What to watch: note pricing and redemption timing, but no risk-arb angle applies.
